# Bethesda: "Kommendes Update Ankündigung"

![Bethesda: `Kommendes Update Ankündigung`](/uploads/631_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**Update 05.02.2026:**

Date Change: @Fallout 76 News!

On Montag, 9. Februar 2026 um 16:00 the game will be brought offline on all platforms to apply the February update mentioned above. We’ll keep you updated on server status when maintenance begins next week.

We also wanted to take a moment to confirm that the team is looking into reports that Daily Ops are not providing the expected rewards. Thank you all for your reports on this!

**Update 04.02.2026:**

Howdy @Fallout 76 News, We wanted to let you know that the update we announced on January 23 will be arriving on ~~February 11~~. That's a bit outside the initial window we mentioned, but the team wanted to take some extra time with this one.

Das Update erscheint also am 11.02.2026.

Betheda hat soeben eine Ankündigung für ein kommendes Update veröffentlicht. Dabei ist nicht das März Update gemeint. Eher ein neuer Hotfix für den aktuellen Stand. Sobald das Datum dafür bekannt gegeben wurde, findet ihr es hier unter Termine.

*Hinweis: Eine Deutsche Version liegt aktuell nicht vor.*

## Hey Vault Dwellers,

We wanted to share some news on an upcoming update the team is working on to address some of the topics that appeared after the Fallout 76 update earlier this week.The team has spent the last few days looking into the reports from across the community and have identified a list of topics that we plan to address in an update that is currently planned for release during the first week of February.We are currently planning for this February update to address the following:

- Build Menu appearing empty due to a skin applied to the C.A.M.P. Module.
- The “New” category of the Pip-Boy acting erratically.
- Grunt and Head Hunts only providing 1-Star enemies.
- C.A.M.P. items that were purchased with Gold Bullion not appearing
- Cryo Status effects and damage not applying to enemies. We’re continuing to investigate reports on other topics such as, Armor resistances not applying unless re-equipped and players feeling “squishier” when fighting enemies in the Burning Springs region.

There were a couple of changes that went undocumented in our release notes on Tuesday (apologies for any confusion this caused). We wanted to highlight these changes to make sure everyone knows that they were intended.

- New 4-Star Legendary Mod “Charged” has been added to items awarded in the Gleaming Depths raid.

- This Melee only mod charges up the weapon with primary attacks. You can release this explosive charge with a power attack.
- Dom Pedro has received two new mods. Reflex Sight and a Long Barrel mod. These mods are available for all owners of the weapon.
**Known Issue**: The Weekly Raid Challenge has been temporarily disabled due to reports that the challenge was automatically completing which resulted in rewards not being obtainable. Thank you all for your patience as we investigated these topics and we’ll update you when we have more information on the specific date and time of the update soon.

Quelle: bethesda.net
